photos.description: Front view shows a rectangular back board, an open mail pocket, a row of key hooks, and two mounting holes.
Side view shows a shallow pocket projecting from the back board.
Detail view shows a bottom shelf, front lip, and side cheek for the pocket.

observations: Back board is taller than the mail pocket so there is room for mounting holes above and hooks below.
Mail pocket is open at the top and front-facing.
Hooks are arranged in a straight horizontal row below the pocket.
